fact: Rhydon was the first Pokémon ever designed, it predates even Pikachu in Ken Sugimori's original sketches.
Arcanine was originally intended to be a Legendary Pokémon. The in-game Pokédex even calls it a 'Legendary Pokémon.'
Magikarp can jump over mountains, according to its Pokédex entry in Pokémon Gold, it can leap almost 10 feet into the air.
There are 18 Pokémon types. When the series started in Gen 1, there were only 15. Dark and Steel were added in Gen 2, Fairy in Gen 6.
Shedinja has exactly 1 HP and never takes damage from moves, but only if they aren't super effective or status-based. This is the Wonder Guard ability.
Pokémon Red and Blue were nearly cancelled. Nintendo of America thought they were 'too boring' and almost didn't localize them.
The Pokémon anime's original episode 'Electric Soldier Porygon' caused 685 children in Japan to have seizures due to flashing lights. It was never re-aired.
Ditto and Mew share the exact same base stat total (100 across all stats) and can both learn Transform. Many fans theorize they're related.
Cubone wears the skull of its dead mother. Its cries are said to sound like her name. This makes it one of the most tragic Pokémon lore entries.
Farfetch'd is so rarely seen that people used to doubt it existed. In the games, a man trades you one, making it rare even in-game.
The Fire/Water/Grass starter triangle is a deliberate game design choice to teach new players about type advantages in a memorable way.
Dragonite can circle the entire globe in just 16 hours, traveling at 1,500 mph, faster than any real-world aircraft.
Wobbuffet's real body is the small black tail at the back. The large blue part is a decoy. Wobbuffet will die to protect the tail.
Bulbasaur is the only starter Pokémon to be dual-typed from the very beginning (Grass/Poison).
In competitive play, Speed is king, a Pokémon that moves first dictates the pace of the entire battle.
Mewtwo was genetically engineered from Mew's DNA. The original Mew was discovered deep in the jungles of Guyana, South America, according to Pokémon lore.
The Pokémon universe has no concept of death for humans in battles. Pokémon simply faint. This was a conscious choice to keep the games family-friendly.
Porygon is the only Pokémon that was entirely man-made using computer programming, no DNA, no cloning, pure code.
Gengar is believed to be the shadow of Clefable, they have nearly identical body silhouettes, and both live in similar mountain/urban habitats.
Pikachu's name comes from the Japanese words 'pikapika' (sparkling) and 'chuu' (the sound a mouse makes).
The 'Rival' in the original games doesn't have a name, the player chooses it. But the manga names him 'Blue' and gives him a fully developed personality.
Pokémon Gold and Silver were developed on the Game Boy, but Satoshi Tajiri insisted on squeezing in an entire second region (Kanto). The team worked overnight for months.
Nidorina and Nidoqueen are the only Pokémon in the Field egg group that cannot breed, despite being in a group defined by breeding.
The Ghost type was originally super effective against Psychic in Gen 1, but due to a programming bug, Ghost moves had no effect on Psychic types at all.
Slowpoke takes 5 seconds to feel pain. If a Shellder bites its tail, the shock eventually reaches its brain and it evolves into Slowbro.
Charizard is not a Dragon type, it's Fire/Flying. This was a deliberate design choice in Gen 1 to make Dragon harder to counter.
The Pokémon Trading Card Game was created because Satoshi Tajiri loved collecting insects as a child and wanted to capture that feeling digitally.
Eevee has the most potential evolutions of any Pokémon, 8 'Eeveelutions', each representing a different type.
Snorlax is the heaviest fully evolved Pokémon available before the Elite Four in Gen 1, weighing over 1,000 lbs.
In Gen 1, the Pokédex entries describe a world where Pokémon genuinely threaten or kill each other. The tone was much darker than the anime.
Every Fire-type starter Pokémon gains a second type upon reaching its final evolution. Charizard (Flying), Typhlosion (stays Fire), Blaziken (Fighting), etc.
Geodude, Graveler, and Golem have a 75% male bias in their gender ratio, a quirk that's never been explained in lore.
Pokémon Snap (N64) was one of the first Pokémon games to feature fully 3D Pokémon models in a real-time environment.
Alakazam has an IQ of 5,000, can remember everything since it was born, and its brain never stops growing, but its body can't support the weight, so it has to use Psychic power to hold itself up.
The move Splash does absolutely nothing, but in the anime, James's Magikarp uses it constantly and is expelled from his team for it.
Shiny Pokémon have a 1 in 4,096 chance of appearing in the wild. Some methods like Masuda Method or Chaining can reduce this to 1 in 512.
The Safari Zone is one of the most controversial mechanics in Gen 1. Pokémon can simply run away and you have no control over catching them.
Gyarados is a Water/Flying type despite looking like a dragon and literally evolving from a fish. It should logically be Water/Dragon.
Pokémon Crystal (GBA) was the first Pokémon game to let you choose a female protagonist, a massive milestone in 2001.
The Pokémon world's currency is 'Pokémon Dollars' (₽). The exchange rate in real life approximately equals the Japanese Yen.
Primeape literally dies if it can't stop raging, according to its Ruby/Sapphire Pokédex entry. It enrages itself to death.
The cover Legendary of each main game is always catchable in that game, but you only get one. This makes Masterball usage a major decision.
Metagross has four brains, each linked together, giving it more processing power than a supercomputer, according to its Pokédex entry.
Gen 2 (Gold/Silver) was the peak of Pokémon in terms of post-game content, you could challenge all 8 Kanto gyms after finishing Johto.
Every Pokémon game has an in-game trade with an NPC that gives you a Pokémon you might miss otherwise, a tradition since Gen 1.
Haunter can paralyze a person by licking them. In one original anime episode, Ash's Haunter accidentally makes a gym leader laugh herself into a coma.
The move Hyper Beam requires a recharge turn, making it a trap for new players who think they're dealing maximum damage efficiently.
Voltorb and Electrode are the only Pokémon whose names are not Japanese in origin, they're pure English compound words.
Blissey has the highest HP of any non-Mega, non-Dynamax Pokémon in the game, a staggering base 255 HP.
The Pokémon Deoxys has 4 different forms. Attack, Defense, Speed, and Normal, each with wildly different stats.
Pokémon Emerald introduced Battle Frontier, widely regarded as the best post-game content in the entire franchise.
Arceus is considered the God of the Pokémon universe. It created the entire world. Dialga (time), Palkia (space), and Giratina (antimatter) from itself.
There's a Pokémon called Spiritomb that has no weaknesses in Gen 4/5, it's Ghost/Dark, and both types cancel out every weakness the other has.
The phrase 'It's super effective!' has become one of the most recognized phrases in gaming culture worldwide.
Pokémon have internal values called IVs (Individual Values) and EVs (Effort Values) that make every single Pokémon numerically unique at a hidden level.
The Safari Zone Glitch in Gen 1 lets you catch Mew through a specific sequence of steps before reaching Cerulean City, without hacking.
Sableye was the only Pokémon with no weaknesses (Dark/Ghost) until Gen 6 introduced the Fairy type, which is super effective against Dark.
Pokémon has sold over 480 million video game copies worldwide, making it the second best-selling video game franchise of all time after Mario.
Unown has 28 forms, one for each letter of the English alphabet, plus '!' and '?'. Its lore suggests it has psychic power in large numbers.
The Ice type is widely considered the worst defensive type in the game, it has 4 weaknesses and only 1 resistance (to itself).
Psyduck has a constant headache so severe it can't use its psychic powers, but when the pain peaks, it unleashes uncontrolled psychic energy.
Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen sold over 12 million copies, proving remakes of Gen 1 games can outsell entirely new generations.
The Dragon type has very few weaknesses (Dragon and Ice) and is resistant to Fire, Water, Grass, and Electric, making it one of the most powerful offensive types.
Rotom can possess electrical appliances, washing machine, microwave, lawnmower, fan, and refrigerator, each giving it a unique second type.
Genesect is a 300-million-year-old fossil Pokémon revived and modified by Team Plasma with a cannon attached to its back.
The name 'Pokémon' is a portmanteau of 'Pocket Monsters', the original Japanese title of the franchise.
Solgaleo and Lunala are Ultra Beasts in disguise, they emerged from wormholes in the Ultra Space and became Legendary Pokémon of Alola.
The Nurse Joy and Officer Jenny you see in every city are not the same person, the anime confirms they're extended family members who all look alike.
Zubat has no eyes. It navigates entirely using echolocation, emitting ultrasonic waves at 40 times per second.
Haunter, Kadabra, and Machoke all evolve through trading, a mechanic designed to encourage players to connect and share with friends.
In Gen 6, the EXP Share was changed to automatically distribute EXP to all Pokémon in your party, removing the need to rotate your team.
Mew is literally said to contain the DNA of every existing Pokémon, making it the biological ancestor of all Pokémon.
Volcarona is one of the most powerful non-Legendary Pokémon competitively, its Special Attack and Speed make it a sweeper at level 59.
The Pokémon anime has aired over 1,200 episodes. It's one of the longest-running animated series in history.
Garchomp's Dragon/Ground typing means it has an immunity to Electric moves and only two weaknesses: Ice and Dragon.
Legendary Pokémon are genderless with a few exceptions (Latios/Latias, Heatran, Cresselia) and cannot breed in standard gameplay.
Tropius grows bananas on its neck. Children in Africa (in the Pokémon world) apparently love eating them, according to its Pokédex entry.
The Steel type was added in Gen 2 specifically to nerf the Psychic type, which was broken in Gen 1. Steel resists Psychic moves.
Pokémon Go became the fastest app to earn $100 million in history, reaching that milestone in just 20 days after its 2016 launch.
Jynx's original design was controversial for bearing resemblance to a racial caricature. It was later redesigned to have a purple face.
Rayquaza stops the battle between Groudon and Kyogre in Ruby/Sapphire, making it effectively the most powerful Pokémon in Hoenn lore.
The Normal type has no super-effective moves. The Ghost type is immune to Normal. This makes Normal moves uniquely unreliable against Ghost types.
Pokémon Legends: Arceus was the first time a main-series Pokémon game had open-world exploration, releasing in January 2022.
Absol appears before natural disasters, not to cause them, but to warn humans. Despite this, it's feared and driven away.
Xerneas can grant eternal life by sharing its energy with others. It sleeps for 1,000 years as a tree to restore that energy.
Incineroar, the Fire/Dark starter, was originally planned as a bipedal wrestler, its design was inspired by professional wrestling heels.
Piplup is the most popular starter in Japan, consistently topping polls, often beating Pikachu in Pokémon popularity rankings.
Ash Ketchum won his first World Championship in Pokémon Ultimate Journeys (2022), ending a 25-year journey as the anime's protagonist.
The 'Type Chart', which type beats which, has 18×18 = 324 type matchup combinations. Mastering it is one of the biggest competitive skills.
Pokémon Silver's data is so packed that the developers had to store the clock data in the save file's leftover bits to fit everything in.
Gible, Gabite, and Garchomp all look like shark-plane hybrids. Their final form is one of the fastest non-Legendary Pokémon at base 102 Speed.
Cosmog is the smallest Legendary Pokémon in the franchise, yet it eventually evolves into Solgaleo or Lunala, universe-spanning beings.
Decidueye, the final form of Rowlet, is Grass/Ghost, making it the only non-pure-Ghost starter to have the Ghost type.
Cinderace's signature move, Pyro Ball, has 120 base power and a 10% chance to burn the target, making it one of the strongest Fire moves.
Toxtricity can be Amped (yellow) or Low Key (blue/purple) depending on its nature, one of the first Pokémon with nature-based form variants.
In Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, Paradox Pokémon are ancient or futuristic versions of existing Pokémon found in Area Zero, bridging past and future.
Urshifu has two forms. Single Strike (Dark) and Rapid Strike (Water), and once you choose, it can't be reversed in the game.
The Poké Ball's design was inspired by a small toy called a Poké Ball that bounced on a string. Satoshi Tajiri owned one as a child.
Spiritomb was specifically designed to have no weaknesses in Gen 4, but players found workarounds using the move Miracle Eye (Psychic) to bypass the Dark immunity.
Chesnaught is the only Grass/Fighting starter final evolution, making it one of the physically bulkiest starters in the franchise.
Legendary Pokémon have been present in every generation, but they weren't always powerful, the original three birds had base stat totals of 580, same as starters.
Magikarp is considered the weakest Pokémon in the game, yet it evolves into Gyarados, one of the most fearsome Pokémon, at level 20.
Eevee has the most evolutions of any Pokémon, with 8 possible evolved forms called Eeveelutions, each tied to a different element.
Ditto can transform into any Pokémon it sees, copying their appearance, moves, and stats. It's the only Pokémon that can breed with almost every species.
The move 'Splash' does absolutely nothing in battle. Its only in-game description is 'No effect.' Yet Magikarp's most iconic move is exactly this.
Smeargle's signature move, Sketch, copies any move used against it permanently. This makes Smeargle theoretically capable of knowing every move in the game.
Wobbuffet can only use four moves. Counter, Mirror Coat, Safeguard, and Destiny Bond, all of which are reactive. It can never initiate an attack.
Alakazam's IQ is said to surpass 5,000. Its brain cells multiply constantly from birth, and it never forgets anything it has ever seen.
Meowth is the only Pokémon in the anime to speak human language naturally, it taught itself by watching humans and imitating speech.
Chansey appears in every Pokémon Center as a nurse assistant. In-universe, Nurse Joys specifically train Chansey because of its gentle nature and healing aura.
Electrode's Pokédex entries say it can explode even without provocation if it absorbs too much electricity, making it one of the most dangerous Pokémon to handle.
Gengar is theorized to be the Ghost form of Clefable, the two have near-identical silhouettes, and no other explanation has been given for Gengar's origin.
The Fairy type was introduced in Generation 6 (Pokémon X/Y) to counterbalance the dominance of Dragon types in competitive play.
Shiny Pokémon have approximately a 1 in 4096 chance of appearing in the wild by default in modern games, making each encounter feel like winning a lottery.
Charizard was explicitly NOT a Dragon-type in Gen 1 despite looking like one, likely a design choice to prevent it from being broken in competitive play.
The Pokémon Company makes more revenue from merchandise than from video games or the anime, making it one of the most lucrative IP licensing operations on the planet.
Lucario can sense and read the Aura of all living things, even predicting the feelings and actions of others before they happen.
The ability Intimidate lowers the opponent's Attack stat upon entering battle. It's been one of the most influential abilities in competitive play since Gen 3.
Milotic was designed as the anti-Gyarados, both evolve from seemingly weak fish Pokémon, but Milotic requires beauty conditions or Prism Scale rather than a level.
Kadabra holds two bent spoons in its claws, a reference to spoon-bending psychics. Uri Geller sued Nintendo in 2000 over the character's name 'Yungeller' in Japanese.
Ninjask is one of the fastest non-Legendary Pokémon, with a base Speed of 160. It's faster than almost every Legendary before Gen 7.
Slaking has the highest base stat total of any non-Legendary, non-Pseudo-Legendary Pokémon at 670, but its ability Truant makes it skip every other turn.
Darkrai causes people to have endless nightmares, but it actually does this out of self-defense, it cannot help inflicting bad dreams on those who get close.
Celebi is a time-traveling Pokémon that appears in forests only when time is at peace. Its presence means the forest has a bright future.
The Berry system in Generation 3 allowed Pokémon to hold berries that automatically healed them in battle, a mechanic that transformed competitive strategy forever.
Metagross is a Steel/Psychic Pokémon formed by the fusion of two Metang, and each Metang is formed by the fusion of two Beldum. It has four brains in total.
Bagon has always dreamed of flying since it was young. It practices by throwing itself off cliffs, which is why its skull has become incredibly tough over time.
In Generation 2, when the player calls Professor Elm's aide on the Pokégear, it turns out to be a criminal already arrested, revealing the robber was caught off-screen.
The Pokémon Trading Card Game has printed over 43 billion cards since 1996, more than 6 cards for every human alive on Earth.
Mewtwo was created through years of horrific genetic engineering experiments on Mew. It's the most powerful Pokémon that was man-made.
Pangoro's Pokédex entry states it never forgives opponents who use dirty tricks, if it sees a Pokémon cheat, it will pursue that enemy to the ends of the Earth.
Goodra is the only pseudo-Legendary Dragon type that isn't part Flying or part Ground, it's pure Dragon with a Fairy-like gentle personality.
Sylveon, the Fairy-type Eeveelution, was introduced in Gen 6 to also serve as a hint about the new Fairy type before X/Y released. It was kept secret at first.
Every 'eeveelution' except Espeon and Umbreon requires an Elemental Stone, making those two the only evolution-by-friendship Eeveelutions.
Dragapult is the fastest pseudo-Legendary ever, with a base Speed of 142, it literally launches its Dreepy children at enemies like missiles.
Regice, Regirock, and Registeel were sealed by ancient humans who feared them. The braille messages on the doors to their chambers describe how and why.
Honchkrow is nicknamed 'Summoner of Night.' It commands flocks of Murkrow and will not forgive any member of its flock that fails to bring home sufficient food.
In the original Japanese games, Ghost-type moves didn't actually hit Psychic-type Pokémon in Gen 1 due to a programming bug, the exact opposite of the intended design.
Lapras was nearly hunted to extinction in the Pokémon world. In-game characters mourn how rare it has become, making the gift Lapras in Silph Co. feel meaningful.
Diglett's feet have never been officially shown. It's one of the longest-running mysteries in the Pokémon franchise, sparking endless fan theories.
Camerupt has a volcano on its back that erupts every 10 years. According to its Pokédex entry, the lava inside is the same temperature as the Earth's mantle.
In Pokémon Diamond and Pearl, Dialga and Palkia were worshipped by the people of Sinnoh as creator deities, the actual gods of time and space.
Shaymin can purify polluted air by absorbing toxins through its flower. When it does, the flowers bloom and the whole area is cleansed.
Yamask carries a mask that resembles its face from when it was human. It occasionally looks at the mask and weeps, one of the darkest Pokédex entries ever written.
Litwick, Lampent, and Chandelure absorb the life force and souls of the living to keep their flames burning, one of the most sinister evolution lines in the game.
Sigilyph was placed by ancient people to serve as a guardian of cities. It flies the same routes forever, never stopping, never changing its patrol path.
Zorua and Zoroark can create perfect illusions of other Pokémon. Zoroark's Illusion ability was a major competitive surprise when Gen 5 launched.
The Legend of Kyurem (Black and White's third box Legendary) is that it is the shell of the original dragon after it split into Reshiram and Zekrom.
Talonflame was one of the most dominant Pokémon in Gen 6 competitive play due to its ability Gale Wings, which gave priority to Flying moves. It was later nerfed.
The move Seismic Toss deals damage equal to the user's level, making it technically deal the same damage to a level 1 Caterpie as to an Arceus.
Hawlucha is a Wrestling Pokémon modeled after the Lucha Libre tradition of Mexican wrestling. Even its fighting style mirrors signature wrestling moves.
Aegislash can switch between a Shield Forme (high Defense) and Blade Forme (high Attack) in the same turn using its King's Shield move.
Hoopa Unbound is one of the most visually imposing Mythical Pokémon, it was sealed inside a Prison Bottle because its power was too dangerous to contain.
Jirachi awakens from a millennium of sleep once every 1,000 years for only seven days, and during that time it can grant any wish.
Bisharp commands armies of Pawniard and leads them in hunts, but if it loses, it's immediately replaced as leader by one of its own subordinates.
The Pokémon world has its own calendar, 'Pokémon time' is the same as real-world time in games like Heartgold and Diamond, syncing with the Nintendo DS clock.
Alolan forms introduced in Gen 7 showed how the same species evolves differently in different environments, a nod to real-world convergent and divergent evolution.
Alolan Marowak is Fire/Ghost because it evolved to channel the spirits of its deceased mothers, a haunting evolution of its original origin story.
Mimikyu wears a Pikachu disguise because it wants to be loved like Pikachu is. Under the disguise is something so horrifying that anyone who sees it falls ill.
Kommo-o has scales that jangle like bells when it moves. Ancient warriors used Kommo-o's shed scales to craft armor and weapons.
Necrozma was originally a being of pure light. Team Rainbow Rocket in USUM attempts to steal its light to power Mega Energy across dimensions.
Zeraora is the fastest Electric-type Pokémon, with a base Speed of 143, it generates electricity by running, creating a field of plasma around itself.
The Sword and Shield Wild Area was the first truly open-world area in a mainline Pokémon game, where the camera could be freely rotated.
Obstagoon is an Alolan Galarian form of Linoone, it only exists because Galarian Linoone in the harsh northern climate evolved an aggressive battling stance.
Zacian and Zamazenta are the legendary wolves of Galar. Zacian carries a sword in its mouth it found after an ancient battle and has used it ever since.
Calyrex is the king of the Crown Tundra, but it's been forgotten and has lost most of its power over the centuries as people stopped believing in it.
Wyrdeer was introduced in Pokémon Legends: Arceus as a rideable Pokémon, the first time Stantler's evolution was shown in over 25 years of the franchise.
Alpha Pokémon in Legends: Arceus are ancient, wild forms of Pokémon, larger, more powerful, and with glowing red eyes. They represent the untamed side of Pokémon.
Iron Hands, a Paradox Pokémon in Scarlet/Violet, is a futuristic robotic version of Hariyama. Its base Attack stat is among the highest of any non-Legendary.
The Tera Type mechanic in Scarlet and Violet lets any Pokémon temporarily change type during battle, even turning a Magikarp into a Dragon type.
Koraidon and Miraidon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet are both rideable Pokémon that serve as mounts for the player from the very start of the game.
The Pokémon franchise spans games, anime, manga, trading cards, toys, clothing, food, and theme park rides, making it the highest-grossing media franchise of all time.
Unown's alphabet forms each correspond to a specific rune. In Pokémon 3: The Movie, a child's longing for her missing father creates real Pokémon using Unown's power.
Move tutors first appeared in Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen, allowing Pokémon to relearn powerful moves they would have otherwise lost by evolving too early.
The Gen 2 games introduced held items, objects a Pokémon can equip to gain passive effects. This single mechanic opened an entire new dimension of competitive strategy.
Flygon is called the 'Desert Spirit', it creates sandstorms by flapping its wings, hiding itself in the chaos while producing a mysterious, humming song.
Wailord is the largest Pokémon by size at 14.5 meters tall, yet it weighs less than Gastly. This is because Wailord has a density even lower than the air.
Feebas is the rarest encounter in Gen 3, it only appears in six random tiles of a large lake in Hoenn, and those tiles change with each secret word entered in Dewford.
A major debate among fans is whether Pokémon can die. Pokédex entries explicitly mention death, and the Marowak in Lavender Town is a confirmed ghost of a dead Pokémon.
The move Minimize causes the user to become so flat that opponents can barely hit it. This doubles the power of Stomping Tantrum and similar spread moves.
Porygon is the only Pokémon created entirely by humans using programming code, making it the world's first artificial Pokémon.
Shuckle holds the record for the most potential single-hit damage in any Pokémon game, through a very specific setup, it can deliver damage in the billions.
The anime episode 'Electric Soldier Porygon' caused seizures in over 685 Japanese children due to a flashing effect, it was never rebroadcast and Porygon never returned to the anime.
Hawlucha's Spanish name is 'Hawlucha', unchanged, because Lucha Libre is so deeply tied to Latin culture that no translation was appropriate.
Slowpoke's tail secretes a sweet sap that Shellder bites onto. This bite transforms Slowpoke into Slowbro, without the Shellder, it would never evolve.
Hitmonchan is named after Jackie Chan, and Hitmonlee is named after Bruce Lee. Gen 1's fighting Pokémon were tributes to martial arts legends.
The Steelix line was the first instance of a Pokémon's evolved form having a lower Speed stat than its pre-evolution, a deliberate trade-off for Defense.
Scyther and Pinsir are counterparts. Scyther is rarer in Red, Pinsir is rarer in Blue. This version-exclusive design has been a franchise trademark ever since.
Hidden Abilities were introduced in Gen 5 via the Dream World feature, rare ability variants only obtainable through online events or special game modes.
Malamar's Pokédex entry says it 'wields the most compelling hypnotic power of any Pokémon' and uses it to manipulate others into doing its bidding.
The Cloud Nine ability (Golduck, Lickilicky) suppresses all weather effects while active, one of the few abilities that can completely override an opponent's strategy.
Zygarde has three forms, 10%, 50%, and Complete, and only reaches 100% power when it senses a threat to the ecosystem it is sworn to protect.
The Pokémon GO Fest events have attracted hundreds of thousands of players to real-world locations, blending augmented reality gaming with live concerts and festivals.
Galarian Slowpoke's tail has been stained yellow with spicy particles from an ancient cave, and local connoisseurs pay fortunes just to taste it.
The Pokémon UNITE MOBA launched in 2021 and reached 70 million downloads within its first month, making it one of the fastest-growing Pokémon games ever.
Fairy-type moves are completely immune to Dragon-type moves, which means even a tiny Clefairy can completely wall a Dragonite in the right matchup.
Pelipper has the ability Drizzle, letting it summon rain upon entry. This ability was originally exclusive to Kyogre, giving Pelipper access to it in Gen 7 shook the competitive scene.
There are 18 Pokémon types in total. When they were introduced across generations, each addition was a deliberate design decision to solve existing balance problems.
Togekiss is known as the 'Jubilee Pokémon', it only appears before kind-hearted people and brings happiness wherever it goes.
The legendary dogs Raikou, Entei, and Suicune were resurrected by Ho-Oh after dying in the Brass Tower fire, each embodies a different aspect of the storm that night.
Tyrogue can evolve into three different Pokémon. Hitmonlee, Hitmonchan, or Hitmontop, depending on whether its Attack, Defense, or both stats are highest at level 20.
